title: StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program Schedule of Tiers, Entry Gates and Go-Live Terms
content:
## Schedule A: tiers of the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program

The StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program is offered at six tiers, listed from the lowest to the highest: StockSmart Self-Scan, StockSmart Monthly Service, StockSmart Biweekly Service, StockSmart Weekly Service, StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service and StockSmart Onsite Storeroom. Each tier has an entry gate of a minimum annual program spend and a minimum number of bins, a number of business days from enrollment to go-live, a one-time setup fee billed at go-live, and storage hardware that Corbett supplies at no charge.

| Tier | Entry gate: annual program spend, USD | Entry gate: bins | Business days from enrollment to go-live | Setup fee at go-live, USD | Hardware supplied at no charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StockSmart Self-Scan | 6000.00 | 25 | 10 | 250.00 | labels only |
| StockSmart Monthly Service | 24000.00 | 75 | 15 | 500.00 | labels and bins |
| StockSmart Biweekly Service | 50000.00 | 150 | 15 | 0.00 | labels and bins |
| StockSmart Weekly Service | 100000.00 | 300 | 20 | 0.00 | bins and shelving |
| StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service | 250000.00 | 500 | 25 | 0.00 | bins and shelving |
| StockSmart Onsite Storeroom | 1000000.00 | 1500 | 45 | 0.00 | full storeroom fit-out |

### Notes to Schedule A

1. A tier's entry gate has two parts, the annual program spend and the bin count; a program meets a tier's gate only when it reaches both figures shown on that tier's row.
2. A setup fee of 0.00 means the tier bills no setup fee; only the StockSmart Self-Scan and StockSmart Monthly Service rows carry one.
3. The go-live figure is a count of business days from the enrollment.

### Reading the schedule (hypothetical figures)

- A hypothetical program with an annual program spend of 30000.00 and 100 bins reaches the StockSmart Monthly Service gate (24000.00 and 75 bins) but not the StockSmart Biweekly Service gate, whose 50000.00 spend and 150 bins it falls short of on both parts.
- A hypothetical program with 60000.00 of annual program spend but only 120 bins reaches the StockSmart Biweekly Service spend figure and not its bin figure, so it does not meet that tier's gate; the highest gate it meets is StockSmart Monthly Service.
